Tamaulipas' anti-corruption prosecutor says the state will ask Interpol for a red notice against former Nuevo Laredo mayor Enrique Rivas Cuéllar — and claims the ex-official has already left the country.

"We are looking for him, and soon we will ask — let's see if our neighbors to the north [the United States] help us — to send him to us as a gift," said Andrés Norberto García Repper Fávila, head of the Fiscalía Especializada en el Combate a la Corrupción, in remarks reported Wednesday.

Rivas Cuéllar, of the PAN, was mayor of Nuevo Laredo from 2016 to 2021 — one of the first mayors in the city's history to win consecutive reelection. He is accused in connection with a 2021 land purchase allegedly made at an inflated price, causing more than 50 million pesos in damage to municipal assets. The criminal case, CP 38/2023, sits before a control judge in Nuevo Laredo on charges of ejercicio ilícito del servicio público and uso ilícito de atribuciones y facultades.

On Oct. 1, a federal collegiate tribunal denied Rivas Cuéllar's amparo against the justified preventive prison ordered in the case — a ruling that cleared the way for his arrest. Since then, the former mayor has vanished from public life: he was conspicuously absent from a PAN gathering photographed Oct. 16 alongside Sen. Imelda Sanmiguel, Nuevo Laredo councilman Félix "El Moyo" García and mayoral hopeful Yahleel Abdalá Carmona.

The prosecutor added that the state is also pursuing the extradition of former governor Francisco Javier García Cabeza de Vaca, saying Tamaulipas has requested procedures through the federal Foreign Ministry (SRE) with support from the Attorney General's Office (FGR): "When it is ready, we will give that notice."

As with every case Webb Watch 956 covers, the accused are presumed innocent until proven guilty in court. What matters for Nuevo Laredo is the question underneath the headlines: whether public money was protected — and whether anyone will answer for it if it wasn't.

Sources: Expreso (Oct. 21, 2026).

— Waldo Wolf, Nuevo Laredo Correspondent, Webb Watch 956

title: Tamaulipas prosecutor says ex-Nuevo Laredo mayor has fled the country; Interpol red notice next
